_excluded.WASHBOARD: NO washboards on this hull, and this is the load-bearing absence. The rig draws a deck margin alongside the house, but measured at the deck line it is 0.076–0.412 m wide (11 samples, y -4.95 → 0.99, widening only as the house nose narrows into the foredeck): a reveal between the house side and the covering board, not a strip anyone walks. It is that narrow by design — clampHW lands the house sides on the cap so the covering board reads as ONE unbroken line stem to transom. Consequence: cockpit and foredeck are separate walkable islands on the exterior.
_excluded.covering_board: The teak cap outboard of the reveal is rolled and carries a toe rail lifting to 0.15 m forward of u=0.55 — a boundary, not a surface.
_excluded.house_interior: Salon is modelled as an exterior volume only — no interior floor exists to walk.
_excluded.bridge_access_interior: No ladder from the cockpit or mezzanine to the flybridge is modelled on this hull — the real route is interior stairs through the salon, which the rig does not build. The tower ladder (bridge → tower) IS modelled.
_excluded.foredeck_access: Nothing in the rig connects the cockpit to the foredeck: no margin wide enough to walk, no ladder, no door in the house exterior other than the aft glass. Any walk-forward move a character makes on this hull has to be authored game-side.
_excluded.gear_above: Outriggers, tower pipework, whips, radomes and rod tubes are gear over the decks, not surfaces. Rod points are ANCHORS.rods.
_excluded.topside_detail: Hull windows, louvre vents and the boot/cove bands are paint and detail, outside any walkable surface.

_confirm.cleat_identification: All three CLEATS entries are read from unlabelled iron fittings (see each provenance). Positions are exact; the reading as tie-offs is the art side’s, and a gameplay ruling can demote any of them.
_confirm.upper_decks: bridge_sole, aft_deck and tower_platform are included because they are real modelled surfaces with real dimensions. If gameplay only ever walks the cockpit, mezzanine, side decks and foredeck, the upper polygons are inert data — they are not a claim that a character can reach them.
_confirm.aft_deck_rail: The 53′ CONVERTIBLE’s aft deck (z=4.66) carries NO rail in the rig — railH:0. Either it is an unguarded edge above the mezzanine or the rail is simply not modelled; a fall rule needs a ruling either way.
